verdict.rationale: Chargebee's first-party docs describe an API Explorer for making live API calls in the browser through a guided interface. That directly delivers an interactive reference where requests can actually be run, and an llms.txt API reference is also served. However, the evidence is a single short doc mention with no detail on per-endpoint code samples. Missing for 10: documented per-endpoint runnable code examples or snippets in the reference, depth of API Explorer coverage across endpoints, and independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can explore an interactive API reference with runnable examples

citations.quote: The API Explorer lets you make live API calls in a browser using a guided interface. Use it to test endpoints without writing code.
